run_rerank_example: run the rerank_example function to rank documents by query relevance using the /rerank endpoint
run_score_example: run the score_example function to compute pairwise query-document scores using the /score endpoint
run_main: run the main function to execute rerank and score examples sequentially
build_rerank_request: build a POST request to the /rerank endpoint with a model, query, and list of documents
build_score_request: build a POST request to the /score endpoint with a model, query text, and list of document texts
